notable_absence.finding: THIS PAGE SPELLS THE ROLE DIFFERENTLY FROM ITS THREE SIBLINGS. This page's Required Permissions line reads 'Full Admin, Backup Admin, or Read-Only Admin role.' - but backup-get-expired-backups.md, backup-get-plan-info.md and backup-get-repository-info.md, covering the same tier of GET/list/info endpoints in the same REST API, all read 'Full Admin, Backup Full Admin, or Read-Only Admin roles.' 'Backup Admin' versus 'Backup Full Admin' is a real naming inconsistency within a single, internally-consistent-looking API reference set - three of four pages agree with each other and one does not. I have minted role:backup-full-admin under THIS page's own spelling ('Backup Admin') since that is what this page's own evidence licenses, and reused the same id (not a second concept) on the other three pages where the fuller name appears - the registry's aliasing mechanism, or reconciliation, should settle on one label, but the discrepancy itself is exactly the kind of docs inconsistency this project's evidence discipline is built to surface rather than silently paper over.

cross_component_finding: This page's three-subdocument cluster response shape (active / imported / archived, each keyed by repository id) is the clearest single piece of evidence that 'imported' is a first-class, load-bearing repository state and not an edge case - it sits as a coordinate peer of active and archived in the very top-level JSON schema the Backup Service returns for 'give me everything you know'. See backup-delete-repository.json for where backup:imported-repository was first minted and cross_component_finding there for why it appears to have no cbbackupmgr-side equivalent.
